propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs which become stale after history rewrite, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic events as key-not-valid-at-era.
The verifier currently trusts stored non-null commit SHAs unconditionally instead of attempting to resolve positions against current history first, making it vulnerable to commit-SHA invalidation.

A commit-history rewrite that preserves tree structure and ticket positions must be supported by treating stored ledger commit SHAs as a cache with current-history position resolution as primary and recorded SHA as fallback.
The authorship-ledger schema, persisted wire format, event bytes, and live-event classification behavior must remain unchanged after the fix.
